failure_and_corrective_action_history.operation_error: Provisioning revision instances to receive traffic. Resource readiness deadline exceeded.
failure_and_corrective_action_history.action: Read revision and service readiness independently; continue on the healthy existing revision without retrying deployment.
failure_and_corrective_action_history.impact: Old model remained at 100% while the new revision reconciled; subsequent tagged inference passed.
failure_and_corrective_action_history.cause_limit: The completed operation error does not establish a persistent revision failure.

rollback.procedure: Review a paired backend/Hosting rollback; the old backend remains pinned to the old predictor tag. An old Hosting version alone still calls the untagged API.
rollback.limits: The changed session key takes effect on reload. Already-open tabs can retain the prior in-memory ontology.
